script_data.title: POV: You confront your former brother who traded his humanity for absolute power

characters.name: Dev
characters.look_en: A battle-worn 25-year-old male warrior with rugged dark hair, wearing battered leather armor with silver trim, holding a glowing steel longsword, with an intense expression of grief and resolve.

characters.name: Vikram
characters.look_en: A formidable 30-year-old ruler in heavy obsidian armor with subtle red glowing runes, slicked-back raven hair, piercing icy eyes, sitting arrogantly on a dark carved throne.

scenes.place: A massive, dimly lit cavernous fortress hall made of dark stone, illuminated by burning braziers and moonlight filtering through high narrow windows.
scenes.desc: Dev slowly steps through the heavy broken doors into the fortress hall, pointing his sword toward the throne.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: You traded your own blood for a throne of shadows, Vikram. Look at what you have become.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: I became what was necessary, little brother.

scenes.place: Close-up on the obsidian throne room elevated above the stone steps, surrounded by swirling dark smoke.
scenes.desc: Vikram leans forward on his throne, resting his chin on his hand, scoffing at Dev's presence.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: You still speak of brotherhood as if that fragile bond could ever survive the song of Bairan.

scenes.place: Center of the fortress chamber, framed tightly on Dev moving steadily closer to the steps.
scenes.desc: Dev grips his sword tighter, his knuckles turning white as dark energy crackles in the air around them.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: The song was meant to protect our people, not enslave them! You sacrificed your soul out of pure fear!

scenes.place: Low angle shot looking up at the high throne as dark shadowy aura pulses behind it.
scenes.desc: Vikram stands up slowly from his throne, towering over the hall as red runes ignite across his black armor.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Humanity is a weakness. The song demands total submission, and today, you will bow just like the rest.
